reviews.review: this game is like crack coke you need this ♥♥♥♥

rather than making a solely positive review, im just gonna go ahead and point out the flaws of the negative reviews, going by order in how common ive seen them:
1. blind pests suck (dlc) - use homing and aoe against them
2. gearbox bad - cope
3. gearbox doesn't update the game - get mods, highly suggest checking most downloaded on thunderstore
4. void bugs suck (dlc) - use aoe against them, they're a bit tanky but things like gasoline or wisps can kill them pretty quickly
5. wisps suck - like blind pests, use homing and aoe against them
6. no (insert ror1/rorr feature here) - get mods, there's mods for basically every ror1 and rorr feature that isn't in ror2
7. too hard - genuinely a skill issue, try drizzle and slowly work your way up, also make sure to get at least a few items on each stage otherwise you won't have a good time
8. too laggy/crashes - lower graphics settings
9. lack of rain - it rains enemies, hence the difficulty names
10. too easy - try eclipse or a modded difficulty
11. too repetitive - don't use command artifact lol, ik you are; also try different characters
12. too much luck involved - don't play roguelikes :/ (all items have some sort of use, although some are only really useful when combined with others)
13. no tutorials - there's explanations for every ability and item in the game, if you don't know what something does, test it (or look it up if you're kinda lame)
14. epilepsy - this is probably the one i agree with the most, there should definitely be an epilepsy warning somewhere in the game due to how much can go on in your screen later on in runs; as a warning, DO NOT play this game if you have epilepsy

anyways that's probably all im gonna do for now, if i've missed anything feel free to comment and point it out
